svg.title: Overall tree size is not resting space
svg.desc: Separate boxes compare example 16 by 12 inch resting footprint with published 12.5 by 12.5 inch Frond top perch spans. Drawings not to scale and rectangular outlines do not reproduce oval geometry.

g.text: Measure the space your cat rests on
The example resting length exceeds a listed side by 3.5 in.
Check shape and usable space; this is not a fit or load guarantee.

Outlines compare measurements, not the product’s oval shape.
